usage: Used to describe something that is grey in colour
Commonly placed before a noun, such as clothes, furniture, phones, or the sky
Can be used on its own when talking about colour choice, appearance, or mood
Often used for neutral-coloured objects, cloudy skies, or dull-looking surroundings
